cells.gaps: The 300 is a count of primary schools in the Wi De Ya rollout phase, not of schools entering data, and no total of primary schools is given with it; nothing is dated after 2023 on its use, and the planned rollouts to 1,500 and 4,000 schools are not confirmed. The newest schools fact, SLE-001 (2026-04-07), is a different system, the Unique Learner ID, still to be piloted with no school yet using it. Rural gap rests on SLE-015: reporting rates lower in some rural chiefdoms, no figure given.
cells.note: Wi De Ya is past its pilot, in a rollout phase the source names, with school leaders in 300 primary schools entering daily attendance per learner: stage 3. Not stage 4, because no share or count with a denominator shows more than half of primary schools entering attendance or results during the year.
